entities.name: Hagra
entities.description: Vast fetid swamp in the Pelakka Karst on Guul Draz, Zendikar.

entities.name: Hagra Cistern
entities.description: Merfolk-built structure meant to cleanse Eldrazi corruption.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans and broods whose corruption the cistern fought.

events.summary: Merfolk engineers and lullmages construct the Hagra cistern after the Eldrazi's first escape; its spells create the Pelakka Karst.
events.quote: merfolk engineers and lullmages constructed the Hagra cistern shortly after the Eldrazi’s first escape

events.summary: The cistern's filters fail over centuries, leaving the swamp a mire of corruption.
events.quote: its filters and drains failed over centuries

relations.quote: It is also home to Malakir , the vampire capital of Zendikar.
Hagra was once part of the ancient Makindi Empire.
